Database._comment: Provider selects which ConnectionStrings entry below is used. One of: Postgres, SqlServer, MySql.

ConnectionStrings._comment: Placeholders only — replace with real credentials via appsettings.Development.json (gitignored), user-secrets, or environment variables. Never commit real passwords.

Jwt._comment: Key must be a base64-encoded string decoding to at least 32 bytes (256 bits). Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32
